description: This file defines a database migration class for the Nextcloud Notes Android client, specifically migrating from version 24 to 25. It adds a new column 'directEditingAvailable' to the 'Account' table and resets the 'capabilitiesETag' field.

classes.name: Migration_24_25
classes.description: A migration class extending Room's Migration to handle database schema changes from version 24 to 25.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Executes SQL commands to alter the database schema and data during migration from version 24 to 25.
